paragraphs.text: Tenza was a legendary equipment on the plane of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War .

Tenza was a flail-like maul composed of a piece of wood with metal spikes sticking out of it. It was held by a long metal chain comprised of various links. It is weilded by Godo , a human warlord of the sanzoku bandits in the Sokenzan mountain range on the plane of Kamigawa . Godo wielded it as he led his bandits to battle and even did so while riding an ox .
